preconditions.description: The number of files n must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 8 and name.islower() for name in file_names)
preconditions.description: Each file name must be a string of 1 to 8 lowercase letters.
The number of file names must match the specified number n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k in import_counts)
preconditions.description: Each file's import count k must be non-negative and not exceed the total number of files n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(imported in file_names for imported in imports) for imports in import_lists)
preconditions.description: All imported files must be valid file names listed in the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'SHIP IT' if not has_cycle else True
postconditions.description: If there are no cycles, output 'SHIP IT'.

postconditions.expression: len(shortest_cycle) > 0 and all(shortest_cycle[i] in import_lists[file_names.index(shortest_cycle[i-1])] for i in range(len(shortest_cycle)))
postconditions.description: If there is a cycle, output the names of files in the shortest cycle in the correct order.
